explanation: The GC removal path scans the registry's token lists by pointer instead of reading an identity hash from an unscavenged token. The new scan advances the matched dictionary entry by one, so dead-token cleanup can access or clear an unrelated entry outside its intended slot.
local_verification: Built out/x64.asan/d8 with gn and ninja. The witness exits 0 and prints 128 on the pinned parent; the edited build exits 139 with SEGV_ACCERR while processing dead tokens.
